title: MEIKO — Tell Me About Your Christmas♪〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: On This Holy Night, I Sing

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright. I think we're done tidying up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. And since we have no shows tomorrow, we can all take it easy for now... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO and KAITO! Hellooo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Emu! Wait for us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, it's you guys! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We came by to let you know we've wrapped up our Christmas show and everything went as planned!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's great! Congratulations, guys!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You all have this look on your faces too.
I'm guessing you did well in the contest?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We did! We have some work left to beat our rivals, but we plan on winning it all with our next show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow! That sounds really exciting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But do you know what's even more exciting♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... What could that be?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! Talking to you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were so busy with the Christmas show, we only got to exchange greetings and never had a chance to actually talk to you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Aww, you guys are sooo sweet!
I was hoping we'd get a chance to talk too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well, your timing couldn't be better.
We're done with shows for the day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right! In that case...
How did you guys all spend Christmas?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Christmas Day...?
I was with my family.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This year it was all of us together, including my sister, so it was more fun than usual!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, so you have a sister?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. She also got to spend Christmas Eve with her friends at a Christmas party like she's always wanted.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They exchanged presents and she has the ones she received decorating her room now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(Hehe, he's so happy for his sister!
He must care about her quite a bit...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And you, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh, m-me? Um, I...
I had cake with my family.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After that, I stayed in my room to watch the stream for an online gaming tournament.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also spent Christmas cooped up in my room.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The electronic components I asked Santa to bring me came right on time and I stayed up until morning assembling them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, what? Electronic components from Santa...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He just means he ordered them online, dummy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's not untrue.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Christmas is just another day to you, isn't it, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
My turn! My turn!
I had a cake party with the mascots!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: With the mascots?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The mascots that sometimes help with our shows at the Phoenix Wonderland's Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In other words, you spent Christmas with friends!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for telling us! It's interesting how each of you enjoyed Christmas in a different way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And did Santa come and visit you all?
Did you find gifts when you woke up?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I used to find presents by my pillow when I was little, but my parents just give them to me directly now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's the same for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really? I always find them outside my door.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To your room? That's interesting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Apparently, I move a lot in my sleep, so they might get knocked over if they're left next to my pillow or something.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My grandpa used to dress up as Santa to bring me presents!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He's gone now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I still get presents.
The mascots bring me them in secret!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They don't know that I figured out it's them, so please don't tell them! It's so much fun every year♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aww, that's so nice of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, our mascots are the best☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Your turn, MEIKO!
How did you spend Christmas?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was with all my friends here in SEKAI. The plushies joined us too and we decided to have a parade!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, right! MEIKO came up with that idea and the plushies were suddenly all for it, so it turned into a big extravaganza.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, a parade! That's so awesome!
I wish I could've been there!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Maybe we'll do it again next year.
If we do, you'll all be invited!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: YEEEAH! Did you hear that, Tsukasa?! Christmas with MEIKO! And we're gonna have a parade!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not deaf, Emu. Calm down! Isn't it too early to be planning for next year's Christmas? I mean, we just had...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But that does pique my interest.
SEKAI parades must be an extraordinary sight.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd love to see one too. It must be so cute with all the plushies marching together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I'll pencil in us in to celebrate Christmas together next year!
